flyer.justification: The flyer is crisp, engaging, and faithful to the talk, though the title exceeds the 6-word limit.

linkedin.justification: The post provides a well-structured and insightful breakdown of the talk's themes, but completely omits the required 3-5 hashtags.

instagram.justification: The post perfectly follows all Instagram formatting requirements, including visual carousel cues, emoji usage, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

summary.justification: The executive briefing is well under the 400-word limit and clearly lays out key metrics, discussion points, and action items.

newsletter.justification: Meets all newsletter criteria with a subject line under 50 characters, three distinct bold subheadings, and an engaging conversational tone.

blog.justification: An excellent long-form blog article with numbered sections, comparison table, strong conclusion, and an accurate About the Author section.
